description: This file is a shell script that contains a series of tests for Git rebase hooks, including setup, execution, validation of hook inputs, and handling of hook failures. It automates testing the behavior of pre-rebase hooks in various scenarios.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting successful execution.

methods.name: test_hook --setup
methods.description: Sets up hook scripts for testing, such as pre-rebase hooks.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Runs commands expecting failure, used to test hook failure handling.

methods.name: test_grep
methods.description: Searches for specific patterns in output or files during tests.

methods.name: test_tick
methods.description: Advances the test timer or state, often used for timestamped commits.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the end of the test script execution.
